business_outcome: Convert meeting notes into concise, fixed-format summaries.
data_availability: Input notes; no training set needed initially
why_this_approach: A focused prompt and structured schema solve the bounded transformation directly; deterministic validation enforces required fields.
rejected_alternative_reason: Training is unjustified before a measured prompt-and-schema baseline fails.
key_risk: Output fields may still be omitted or malformed.
discovery_question: Which fields and quality thresholds define success?
validation_plan: Test representative notes for completeness, schema validity, concision, latency, and cost.

business_outcome: Answer employee questions from current approved policies with traceable sources.
privacy_security: Permission-filter retrieval and protect private text
why_this_approach: Retrieval supplies current approved passages and citation metadata without making model weights the policy store.
rejected_alternative_reason: Changing policies would require repeated updates and tuned weights do not inherently cite sources.
key_risk: Relevant evidence may be missed or access controls may be applied incorrectly.
discovery_question: Which approval states and user permissions control retrievable passages?
validation_plan: Measure corpus coverage, Recall@K, groundedness, citation validity, permissions, latency, and abstention.

business_outcome: Improve specialized output consistency for a high-volume workflow.
privacy_security: Verify provenance, consent, retention, and sensitive-data handling
latency_cost_constraints: High volume makes prompt size and inference cost material
why_this_approach: A measured prompt baseline remains inconsistent and reviewed examples exist, making tuning a testable behavior improvement. Schemas and deterministic post-processing still enforce hard constraints.
rejected_alternative_reason: More prompt expansion does not address demonstrated inconsistency and may increase cost.
key_risk: Unrepresentative or inconsistent training examples can teach regressions.
discovery_question: Does tuning beat the frozen prompt baseline on held-out quality, latency, and cost?
validation_plan: Use train/validation/test splits and compare behavior, schema validity, safety, regressions, latency, and cost.

business_outcome: Answer support questions from current product manuals and release notes.
why_this_approach: Retrieval can select current version-specific passages and preserve citations while documents update independently.
rejected_alternative_reason: Tuning documentation into weights creates freshness and traceability problems.
key_risk: Results may mix obsolete and current product versions.
discovery_question: Which product version, release channel, and customer entitlement should filter retrieval?
validation_plan: Test version-aware retrieval, stale-document exclusion, grounded answers, citations, and update propagation.

business_outcome: Make exactly reproducible, auditable eligibility decisions.
knowledge_source: Explicit versioned rules and validated inputs
privacy_security: Protect decision inputs and audit logs
why_this_approach: Deterministic code guarantees repeatable evaluation of explicit rules and records which rule version produced each result.
rejected_alternative_reason: Natural-language generation cannot guarantee exact reproducibility.
key_risk: An incorrectly implemented or poorly governed rule can fail systematically.
discovery_question: Can every criterion be represented as an explicit validated input and rule?
validation_plan: Use decision tables, boundaries, regression tests, audit checks, and business-owner sign-off.

business_outcome: Provide current cited internal answers with reliable specialized behavior.
knowledge_source: Current private documents plus reviewed behavior examples
knowledge_freshness: Knowledge changes; behavior is comparatively stable
data_availability: Documents exist; example quality must be verified
privacy_security: Access-control retrieval and protect training data
latency_cost_constraints: Combined path must meet service targets
why_this_approach: RAG owns current cited knowledge; fine-tuning is considered only for measured persistent behavior failures.
rejected_alternative_reason: Tuning alone is not a current, traceable store for changing private knowledge.
key_risk: Tuned behavior may weaken grounding or expose sensitive training data.
discovery_question: Which behavior failures remain after the measured RAG baseline?
validation_plan: Compare frozen RAG and combined systems on grounding, citations, behavior, privacy, regressions, latency, and cost.
staged_approach: Build and freeze a RAG baseline

business_outcome: Answer questions from one short policy with minimal infrastructure.
knowledge_source: Complete short policy in the request
privacy_security: Policy is approved for request context
why_this_approach: The entire bounded source fits safely in context, so retrieval infrastructure adds no present value.
rejected_alternative_reason: A vector index is premature for one short stable document.
key_risk: The model may answer beyond the policy rather than abstain.
discovery_question: Will corpus size or policy length grow beyond the context budget?
validation_plan: Test supported and unsupported questions, conditions, abstention, format, latency, and token cost.

business_outcome: Discover the actual outcome and constraints before choosing an architecture.
privacy_security: Unknown access, retention, and sensitivity constraints
why_this_approach: The request does not distinguish changing knowledge from persistent behavior and omits essential success and governance requirements.
rejected_alternative_reason: No behavioral target, reviewed training set, or baseline has been established.
key_risk: A premature solution may leak private data, become stale, and solve the wrong problem.
discovery_question: What outcome is required; is this knowledge or behavior; how often does it change; are citations, deterministic decisions, privacy controls, reviewed examples, and accuracy, latency, and cost targets required; and what baseline exists?
validation_plan: Resolve discovery, define measurable criteria, inventory approved data, establish the simplest baseline, and compare viable architectures.
